steps.en: Install Dramatiq and run RabbitMQ or Redis
steps.zh: 安装 Dramatiq，运行 RabbitMQ 或 Redis

steps.en: Decorate a Python function as an actor
steps.zh: 把 Python 函数装饰成 actor

steps.en: Start supervised workers that import the actor module
steps.zh: 启动并托管导入 actor 模块的 worker

steps.en: Send the actor arguments from application code
steps.zh: 从应用代码发送 actor 参数

steps.en: JSON-encodes a message and puts it on the broker
steps.zh: 把消息编码为 JSON 并放入 broker

steps.en: Consumes the message, runs the actor, and retries failures
steps.zh: 消费消息、运行 actor，并重试失败任务

value.en: Durable Python work leaves the request path and runs in a separately scaled worker fleet
value.zh: 持久 Python 工作离开请求路径，在独立扩展的 worker 集群中运行
